about_the_game:
Venture into the forgotten depths of Navel, the massive underground labyrinth built by the dwarves, now overrun by the horrors of the Great War of Menegroth.

Description

Centuries ago, the dwarves abandoned their ancestral home, sealing entire armies of the undead within the vast caverns of Navel. Deadly traps and labyrinthine corridors were constructed to contain the dark plague. But where there’s danger, there’s also glory and unimaginable wealth.

You are a daring adventurer who dares to enter these cursed catacombs, facing endless waves of the undead while seeking fame, treasures, and the secrets of the dreaded necromancer generals of Menegroth.

Key Features

Survive the impossible – Face ever-growing waves of the undead while leveling up and enhancing your abilities with each run.
Addictive progression – Collect relics, unlock new powers, and create devastating builds to survive longer.
Dark and treacherous environments – Explore abandoned dwarven cities, trap-filled mines, and temples defiled by dark magic.
Terrifying enemies and bosses – Battle horrific creatures and the necromancer generals guarding forbidden secrets.

Multiple characters and playstyles – Choose between warriors, mages, and hunters, each with unique abilities.

Eternity awaits those who dare challenge the darkness… Will you survive?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 320, 1 GB or AMD Radeon HD 5570, 1 GB or Intel HD 4600
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10, 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core I5-8500 or AMD Ryzen 5 5600G
  • Graphics: NVidia GTX 950, or AMD Radeon HD 5570, 1 GB or Intel HD 4600
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Enter the cursed catacombs of Navel, an ancient dwarven realm overrun by undead horrors. Survive endless waves of enemies, uncover hidden treasures, and unlock powerful abilities in this fast-paced, roguelike survival adventure. Will you conquer the darkness?
